slides.headline: 1) FIND EVERY HIDDEN FEE IN YOUR SUPPLIER CONTRACT
slides.body:
VENDOR CONTRACTS BURY EXTRA FEES PAGES DEEP.

"Here is my vendor contract. List every fee not in the headline price, with the page number."

slides.headline: 2) CATCH PRICE INCREASES HIDING ACROSS YOUR INVOICES
slides.body:
VENDORS RAISE PRICES IN SMALL STEPS THAT COST THOUSANDS. Paste 3 recent invoices and type:

"Here are my last 3 invoices. Flag every line where the price went up and explain why."

slides.headline: 3) SPOT RED FLAGS IN ANY VENDOR PITCH
slides.body:
VENDOR PITCHES ARE BUILT TO IMPRESS, NOT INFORM. Run any pitch through Claude and type:

"List every claim in this pitch that sounds strong but offers no real proof."

slides.headline: $340,000 A YEAR
slides.body: That is what one pharma rep made selling cancer drugs that didn't work. Your vendors hide things too.

slides.headline: 4) FIND YOUR VENDOR'S TRUE ANNUAL COST
slides.body:
THE QUOTED PRICE IS NEVER THE REAL PRICE. Paste your contract and ask:

"Calculate my true annual cost including all minimums, renewal penalties, and early exit fees."

slides.headline: 5) WRITE THE EMAIL THAT CUTS YOUR VENDOR BILL
slides.body:
MOST VENDORS ONLY MOVE WHEN THEY THINK YOU'LL LEAVE. Tell Claude your situation and ask:

"Write a negotiation email asking for 15% off, pointing to my order volume as the reason."

hook_sharpen.why: The $340,000 specific number hits with immediate shock—'WAIT, WHAT?'—in a way that stops scrolling, while 'expose every fee' addresses a real problem but feels less dramatic without the crystallizing dollar figure. Hard numbers beat relatable concepts for 2am impact.
